powers.title: Clown-car capacity
powers.detail: One more ally can fit. They were already in there.

powers.title: Thesis pie
powers.detail: A cream pie that hits the weak point of a speech.

powers.title: Unicycle balance
powers.detail: Stay upright on a point that should not hold.

powers.title: Emphasis maracas
powers.detail: Every third word gets a shake. The shake is persuasive.

powers.title: Authority mustache
powers.detail: A disguise so thin it becomes a leadership style.

powers.title: Spring-loaded handshake
powers.detail: Surprises the other hand into agreeing.

powers.title: Bubble-wrap armor
powers.detail: Loud when struck, and weirdly effective.

powers.title: Sincere whoops
powers.detail: May undo one small disaster by admitting it out loud.

powers.title: Parade permit
powers.detail: A crowd forms because the paperwork says it can.

powers.title: Rubber-chicken gavel
powers.detail: Calls order. The room is confused, and listening.

powers.title: Infinite hat
powers.detail: Another hat under the hat. The fifth one has a plan.

powers.title: Selective laugh track
powers.detail: Plays only when you were actually funny. It has standards.

powers.title: Invisible, but only when no one's looking
powers.detail: The trick ends the moment anyone checks.

powers.title: Rides a T-rex
powers.detail: The dinosaur has opinions about traffic.

powers.title: Has 1,000 bees
powers.detail: They have a group chat and a destination.

powers.title: Immortal but allergic to everything
powers.detail: Forever, between sneezes.

powers.title: Can teleport, but only 3 feet
powers.detail: Arrives slightly to the left of the point.

powers.title: Is 50 feet tall
powers.detail: Ducks through doorways that were not the plan.

powers.title: Armed with a shotgun that shoots shotguns
powers.detail: Each blast files its own paperwork, loudly.

powers.title: Armed with a superglue fire hose
powers.detail: The hose is committed. So is everyone it hits.

powers.title: Armed with an infinite sausage lasso
powers.detail: A lasso with seasoning and no upper limit.

powers.title: Locked in a shark cage
powers.detail: Safe, wet, and unable to reach the snacks.

powers.title: Made of guacamole
powers.detail: Delicious, and structurally a suggestion.

powers.title: Believes they are invisible
powers.detail: Waves. Everyone waves back. The bit continues.

powers.title: Really stupid
powers.detail: The plan is bold because the plan is missing.

powers.title: No bones
powers.detail: Collapses with confidence, and keeps talking.

powers.title: Flying at the speed of molasses
powers.detail: Airborne, technically. The calendar disagrees.

powers.title: Bottom half is a unicycle
powers.detail: The top has ideas. The wheel has one.

powers.title: Constantly playing a kazoo
powers.detail: Every speech gets a solo nobody requested.

powers.title: Shoots spaghetti from fingers
powers.detail: Ten noodle streams. Sauce sold separately.

powers.title: Turns into a couch
powers.detail: Very comfortable. Cannot move.

powers.title: Every step squeaks
powers.detail: Like a dog toy. Sneak attacks are out.

powers.title: Followed by a mariachi band
powers.detail: They play the dramatic parts, loudly.

powers.title: Only speaks in rhymes
powers.detail: Every threat is a little poem. It loses some menace.

powers.title: Head is a lamp
powers.detail: Lights up any room. Moths are a serious problem.

powers.title: Sneezes glitter
powers.detail: Blinds enemies. Ruins carpets.

powers.title: Noodle arms
powers.detail: Wet-noodle arms. Very flexible, zero grip.

powers.title: Shopping cart at highway speed
powers.detail: Rides it everywhere. One wheel squeaks.

powers.title: Pet rain cloud
powers.detail: Rains on enemies. Sometimes on them, out of spite.

powers.title: Teleports, but always into a lake
powers.detail: Arrives instantly. Arrives wet.

powers.title: Controls only the color beige
powers.detail: Total command of one very boring color.

powers.title: Turns into a pigeon when nervous
powers.detail: The more nervous they get, the more pigeon.

decks.blurb: Logic left the room, and it took the door.

tiebreakers.title: Your character vs. theirs in a pizza eating contest
